The LAST RUN DIFF (changelog.d/6118-…:4-10 and agents.md:1723) added the SECURITY_PASS_PENDING_STALE_HOURS row but not the paired SINGLE_ISSUE_SECURITY_PASS_ENABLED row, even though both are referenced by `changelog.d/6118-phase-8a-single-issue-security-pass.md:11-12` and `README.md:148, 1722`.

- scripts/review_single_issue_security_pass.sh:177-179
  PROBLEM: When a `pending` marker matches the current head but `latest_created` is somehow empty (e.g., a comment object missing `created_at`), `python3 -c '...fromisoformat(sys.argv[1].replace...)' "${latest_created}"` fails inside `2>/dev/null`, the `|| echo 0` fallback gives age_hours=0, and the gate then holds via the `[ "${age_hours}" -lt "${stale_hours}" ]` check (0 < 6).
  WHY: Defensively short-circuiting on `[ -n "${latest_created}" ]` saves one `python3` subprocess per gate run when the field is empty and avoids the silent `fromisoformat("")` exception path.
